blurb: The Rainbow Rivers Club is a family & pet friendly vacation resort. We offer access to two of Florida’s premier rivers including the world-renowned Rainbow River and its crystal clear waters. Come stay with us in one of our Cabins on our 55 acre Nature Preserve. All of our two bedroom Rustic Cabins have central AC, full kitchens, screened in porches and access to our numerous amenities.
